text:
# Close wrap, Tue 2026-11-03 (~4:25 PM ET)

1. **Indexes:** S&P +0.35% to 7,568.05, Nasdaq +0.83% to 25,365.67, Dow -0.40% to 51,782.29 (prelim). AI names bounced after the Nasdaq-100's correction, but most S&P stocks fell; NYSE decliners beat advancers 1,616 to 1,177 ([MarketScreener/Reuters](https://ca.marketscreener.com/news/nasdaq-ends-higher-as-ai-heavyweights-rebound-ahead-of-midterm-results-ce785fdedd8ef520); [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stocks-mixed-at-close-of-trade-dow-jones-industrial-average-down-046-4996317)).
2. **Covered tickers:** MSFT +3.0% ($522.40), AMZN +2.7% ($252.23), NVDA +2.4% ($206.87); chips and MU up; AAPL fell on its memory-cost margin warning ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stocks-mixed-at-close-of-trade-dow-jones-industrial-average-down-046-4996317); [AP](https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-ai-earnings-oil-0d235af127a92c68da0cc2c45c028cef)). AMD ran ~5% into its report; options priced ~7% move ([Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4663926-amd-expected-to-move-7-following-earnings-options-markets-indicate)).
3. **Earnings winners/losers:** FISV +12.6% (EPS beat, savings target doubled to $1B, $500M Q4 buyback, guide only reaffirmed) ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/798354/000079835426000039/fisvq326earningsrelease.htm)); RVTY +10.0%, DD +8.4% to $153.22. Midday laggards: IT -12%, ZBRA -9%, SYY -9%, SHOP -8%, ADM -8% ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/amd-earnings-setup-why-a-beat-may-not-be-enough-93CH-4996067)).
4. **After hours:** AMD, ANET, SMCI, XYZ, DUOL, AMGN reported; reactions not confirmed at writing, so no AH numbers here.
5. **Oil:** eased on Ukraine/Iran talk; Iran says a deal is still far off (Reuters, link 1). Energy stays in avoid.
6. **Tomorrow:** midterm results overnight; ADP 8:15, ISM Services 10:00; UBER, MCD, DDOG, NVO, CVS before the open; QCOM, ARM, APP after.

## Swing ideas
- **RVTY** long, low. FY guide raised, +10% close; logged at the close per our gap rule. Risk: big gap can fade; tools trade with risk appetite.
- **DD**: hold, no re-add (+8.4% today).
